title: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando Reportedly Marry in Palm Springs
excerpt:
Entertainment Tonight reports that the musicians married in California on Saturday.
The couple first met in 2021 and later collaborated on music.
body_md:
Miley Cyrus and musician Maxx Morando have married in Palm Springs, California, according to Entertainment Tonight, as reported by The Hollywood Reporter. TMZ had previously reported that a wedding was expected over the weekend.

On Friday, Cyrus's stepsister Lily-Rose Purcell shared images from a rehearsal dinner. The decorations included crimson flowers and menus bearing the initials M+M.

The couple met on a blind date in 2021 and have since collaborated professionally, including on Cyrus's albums Endless Summer Vacation and Something Beautiful.

Their engagement became public in December 2025 after Cyrus appeared with a ring at the Avatar: Fire and Ash premiere. She also contributed the song Dream as One to that film.

Cyrus was previously married to actor Liam Hemsworth. They married in 2018 and divorced in 2020. Details of the latest ceremony have so far emerged mainly through entertainment reporting and posts by family members.
